== Biography ==

Johnny Dooit is a small man summoned by the shaggy man through the power of the Love Magnet, called with the words "Dear Johnny Dooit, come to me. I need you bad as bad can be." When Dorothy asks what he can do, the shaggy man answers "Anything," with confidence. Johnny Dooit has a broad nose that sticks up a little and eyes that are twinkling and merry; his hands and arms are as hard and tough as the leather of the apron he wears, giving Dorothy the impression that he has done a great deal of hard work in his lifetime. According to the account of that day, once summoned he quickly builds a sand-boat to carry the shaggy man, Dorothy, and their companions across the Deadly Desert; the boat crashes into rocks at the desert's far edge, though the travelers land unharmed in the Country of the Winkies.

== Relationships ==

'''[[Dorothy]]''' — acquaintance. Johnny Dooit seems to have been introduced to Dorothy by the shaggy man.

'''[[THE shaggy man]]''' — friend. Their bond appears tied to the Love Magnet, which the shaggy man describes as drawing to him "a powerful friend."

'''[[Princess]]''' — acquaintance. Johnny Dooit appears to have thanked the Princess for her hospitality.
